items.title: Reddit Sinks 6% as Traffic Falls 13% on Google’s AI Overviews: “Not Traffic Drivers”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 6% after Similarweb data showed a 13% drop in global visits, which Business Insider blamed on Google’s AI Overviews. Most of the lost visits were logged out, and the logged-in users behind over 80% of its monetization are still growing.
